slash_commands_not_executed.finding: Earlier attempts to run /goalanchor-status and /goalanchor-guard on produced no output and no plugin.log command events.
slash_commands_not_executed.observed: Three attempts were made in restored and fresh sessions, all with no effect.
slash_commands_not_executed.interpretation: SUPERSEDED on 2026-11-13T16:49 by guard_command_executed below. The real cause was two host-specific submission behaviours, not a blocked extension command surface: (a) the PI-Desktop composer inserts a newline on Enter and requires the Send button, and (b) the window was taller than the 1536x864 screen, so the Send button sat off-screen and coordinate clicks landed outside the window.
slash_commands_not_executed.not_a_conclusion_about: It never showed the guard logic was wrong; guard.cjs was untested at that point.

guard_command_executed.submission: composer Send button (Enter only inserts a newline in this host)
guard_command_executed.host_result_text: GoalAnchor Guard 已启用。后续涉及计划、调查或执行的任务将先经过 PLAN → VERIFY → EXECUTE；当前无具体任务，未执行任何操作。
guard_command_executed.interpretation: First real execution of a GoalAnchor extension command on plugin 0.9.3 in PI-Desktop 0.22.0. The agent extension command surface works; earlier failures were UI-submission and window-geometry problems on this machine, not a host publication defect.

window_geometry_note.problem: PI-Desktop opened at 1750x1020, taller than the screen; the composer Send button was off-screen, so synthesized clicks landed outside the window and commands never submitted.
window_geometry_note.resolution: Resized the window to 1480x800 inside the screen bounds with MoveWindow, after which the Send button became reachable and the command executed.
window_geometry_note.caution: Forcing MoveWindow to an out-of-screen size once produced a black client area; a full host restart recovered it. Prefer keeping the window within the primary screen when driving this host.

manifest_command_experiment.temporary_change: Added goalanchor-status, goalanchor-python, goalanchor-guard, goalanchor-approve and goalanchor-check to contributes.commands in the source manifest, built and installed the package, then fully restarted PI-Desktop.
manifest_command_experiment.observed_result: The extension commands still did not appear in the command palette or composer, and no new extension command events appeared in plugin.log. The manifest-declared capabilities command remained the only visible command.
manifest_command_experiment.decision: Manifest-only change is insufficient and unnecessary; source manifest and installed package were restored to the original 0.9.3 shape with only goalanchor.capabilities.
manifest_command_experiment.remaining_blocker: None for command exposure: extension commands publish and run once the composer can actually submit them. The earlier 'publication blocker' reading is withdrawn.
